measurement_method.baseline_source: working tree captured before this goal-seek implementation; git HEAD was not used
measurement_method.after_source: production plugin-plans/harness-creator/task-graph.json and execution-unit-contract.json emitted by their CLIs
measurement_method.counts: JSON object and array lengths; depends_on is the edge.type count

baseline.compiled_obligation_scope: draft build:C01 through build:C08 only; release/global claims were not exhaustively assigned

control_plane.input_resolution: single-task API only; raw claim dependencies were resolved for each task
control_plane.state_writeback: one task transition per process invocation and atomic state write
control_plane.heartbeat: one task renewal per process invocation and atomic state write
control_plane.dispatch: raw pending task IDs could cause an unconditional resolver/dispatch subprocess per claim
control_plane.phase_roots: not mechanically typed and had no proof-driven no-Agent projection

dependency_projection.scheduler_policy: draft P01 -> P02 -> P05, then release P03 -> P04 -> P06 -> P07 -> P08 -> P09 -> P10 -> P11 -> P12 -> P13; each phase preserves route/coupling prerequisites

control_plane.input_resolution: one execution-unit resolver invocation; artifact_path values are deduplicated and producer_task_ids retain claim coverage
control_plane.state_writeback: repeatable task IDs validate as one batch and commit through one atomic fsync+replace write; single-task CLI remains compatible
control_plane.heartbeat: repeatable task IDs renew as one batch and commit through one atomic fsync+replace write; single-task CLI remains compatible
control_plane.dispatch: one dispatch subprocess per ready execution unit; raw claim dependencies remain provenance and are not re-applied over the stage scheduler
control_plane.phase_gates: zero-Agent projection only after all exact child claims are done and have existing, covering, unique evidence refs

grouping_decision.target_interpretation: route×stage was refined to the minimum quality-preserving route×phase stage unit
grouping_decision.why_not_24_units: A simple draft/release merge would put P02 and P05 in one route unit while the raw 13-phase graph places release P03/P04 between them. Conversely, blindly contracting the raw phase barriers would defer P05 behind P04 and break the usable-draft contract. Forty-eight units preserve each quality phase while the scheduler explicitly implements the established draft order P01/P02/P05 before release.
grouping_decision.invariant_priority: phase and usable-draft quality ordering takes precedence over the approximate 24-unit target
